text: Underway here in the second round.
Tortoise on the comms urging calm early on, promising to mind the shop at the back.
Griezmatronn is clean through on goal in the middle!
Fires wide from close range, a huge let-off for Fable.
GOAL! Robodinho pounces from point-blank range to put Synthetic Athletic one-nil up!
Tortoise rumbles through the middle into the attacking third.
Tortoise drags it agonizingly wide of the near post.
Another golden opportunity squandered right in front of the net!
Fable are sustaining relentless pressure here, pinning Synthetic Athletic right up against their own back wall.
Robodinho breaks the siege, cleverly steering the magenta ball up the right channel.
Hare radios back, covering behind.
Robodinho surges down the left.
GOAL! Robodinho strikes again from the left channel, doubling Synthetic Athletic's lead to make it two-nil!
GOAL! Tortoise bundles it home from the right channel! AFC Fable are right back in this at one-two!
Hare loses balance in the centre circle.
Fable teammates collide heavily in attack!
Hare clatters into Robodinho to win possession, leaving the Brazilian-coded unit sprawling on the turf.
Corner panel ejects the ball!
And Hare is clean through on the right channel with the goal at their mercy!
Synthetic Athletic are completely trapped in their own half as the terracotta shirts turn the screw.
A dreadful mix-up as the Synthetic Athletic teammates crash together!
Robodinho crunches Hare into touch.
The corner push-panel hammers it right back out.
Hare retaliates with a hefty challenge, flattening Robodinho in the defensive third.
Hare floors Griezmatronn as well!
Hare stumbles right on the line!
GOAL! Hare somehow scrambles it in from point-blank range! It's two-two!
'Fast AND finished this time!' crows Hare over the airwaves, celebrating that chaotic equaliser.
After that opening barrage from Real Machina earlier today, both these sides are serving up an absolute treat of end-to-end humanoid combat.
Griezmatronn powers all the way up the left touchline.
Griezmatronn is clean through on goal on the left touchline!
'Mine! No naps today,' radios Hare, determined to keep Synthetic Athletic at bay.
GOAL! Robodinho bags his hat-trick with a neat finish from the right channel! Synthetic Athletic lead three-two!
Robodinho storms straight through the middle again.
GOAL! Robodinho turns it in point-blank for his fourth of the match! Synthetic Athletic make it two-four!
Hare rallies Tortoise over the radio.
There's the half-time buzzer. Synthetic Athletic take a commanding four-two lead into the break after a masterclass from Robodinho.
Tortoise drives right down the middle!
GOAL! Tortoise hammers it home from three metres out! AFC Fable pull one back, it's three-four!
Tortoise breaks clean through on the right channel, completely untracked!
Inches wide of the post from Tortoise!
Tortoise misses the target from point-blank range, somehow letting Synthetic Athletic off the hook.
Tortoise radios: 'Mine — slow and steady,' calmly looking to orchestrate the next move from the touchline.
A brief pause in the drama to allow the servomotors to catch up. Fable look full of belief here in this second period.
Hare flashes a shot just past the upright from close range on the left channel.
Robodinho radios their plan to play the wall.
Fable lay siege once more.
A clearance skims dangerously close to their own goal mouth!
Push-panel launches it back inside!
Synthetic Athletic collide, Griezmatronn falls!
Griezmatronn trips up Hare 2m out!
GOAL! Tortoise turns in the loose ball on the goal line! We are level at four-four!
Synthetic Athletic press high, penning Fable against their goal line.
GOAL! Agony for Fable as Hare deflects it into their own net! It's four-five to Synthetic Athletic!
Griezmatronn tumbles in midfield.
Robodinho slides into Tortoise, sending the Fable defender crashing onto the turf.
Hare is clean through on the left touchline!
Hare drives toward the goal.
Hare loses footing and collapses!
'Going for the ball near the wall,' signals Robodinho as both robots scramble in the corner.
GOAL! Hare recovers to poke it over the line! What resilience, we are tied at five-five!
Off the post! You cannot get any closer than that without scoring!
GOAL! Disaster for Griezmatronn who turns it into their own net! AFC Fable lead six-five!
Robodinho surges straight through.
GOAL! Unbelievable, Tortoise turns it into the Fable net for another own goal! It is six-six!
GOAL! Robodinho snatches victory right at the death for Synthetic Athletic, six-seven!
Full time: AFC Fable 6, Synthetic Athletic 7. What an astonishing contest.
